items.title: Isidore Barbarin Interview, 1959-01-07
items.q: They had, if I can remember, Manuel Perez, Peter Boccage, Andrew Kimball, Vic Gasper, Buddy or Yank Johnson? ... Vic Gasper. He was playing baritone and slide.

ctx.x: Oh, both of them. Yank. Yank. Yank was his name. Let's see. And, forget who. Vic Gasper. Buddy Adolph Alexander.
Vic Gasper. He was playing baritone and slide. He's dead. Yes.
Buddy Adolph Alexander. Did he play?
